scripts.test: bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; ROOT="$(cd .. && pwd)"; have_cmd(){ command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; }; kill_listen_port(){ port="$1"; pids=""; if have_cmd lsof; then pids="$(lsof -nP -iTCP:"$port" -sTCP:LISTEN -t 2>/dev/null | sort -u || true)"; elif have_cmd ss; then pids="$(ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep -E "LISTEN.*[:.]${port}\\b" | grep -oE "pid=[0-9]+" | cut -d= -f2 | sort -u || true)"; fi; if [ -n "${pids}" ]; then echo "Port ${port} is in use (pids: ${pids}). Killing..."; for pid in ${pids}; do kill -TERM "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || true; done; fi; }; cd "$ROOT"; bash start_consul.sh local & STACK_PID=$!; cleanup_stack(){ kill -TERM "$STACK_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$STACK_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; }; trap cleanup_stack EXIT; consul_ok=0; for _ in {1..240}; do if curl --noproxy "*" -fsS --connect-timeout 0.25 --max-time 1 http://localhost:9000/healthz >/dev/null 2>&1; then consul_ok=1; break; fi; sleep 0.25; done; if [ "$consul_ok" != "1" ]; then echo "Consul did not become ready at http://localhost:9000/healthz"; exit 1; fi; kill_listen_port 8880; cd "$ROOT/sokoyuku-app"; npm run dev & VITE_PID=$!; cleanup_all(){ kill -TERM "$VITE_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$VITE_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; cleanup_stack; }; trap cleanup_all EXIT; app_ok=0; for _ in {1..120}; do if curl --noproxy "*" -fsS --connect-timeout 0.25 --max-time 1 http://localhost:8880/ >/dev/null 2>&1; then app_ok=1; break; fi; sleep 0.25; done; if [ "$app_ok" != "1" ]; then echo "App did not become ready at http://localhost:8880/"; exit 1; fi; playwright test --reporter=list "$@"' --
